canonical_industry_source: Must equal one of the canonical `industry` strings already governed in src/finengine/catalog.py's GROUPS industry scope_value and documented in docs/MASTER_SCHEMA.md, so a company's existing reviewed industry classification is what selects this pack -- no new classification taxonomy is introduced.
notes: sector_specific_fields is not_applicable for transportation/logistics: catalog.py's 'transportation_logistics' GROUPS entry only defines transport_operations KPI fields, with no distinct sector-specific statement template.

This pack deliberately keeps the required-field list sub-mode-agnostic (fleet_size, fleet_utilization, cargo_volume rather than, say, passengers_carried alone) because catalog.py's single 'Transportation & Logistics' scope covers passenger carriers (airlines), cargo shipping (bulk/tanker), and port/logistics operators together; a pure-cargo shipper is not penalized for lacking passenger-specific fields like passenger_load_factor, which remain recommended rather than required.

on_time_performance for a shipping/port operator (vs. an airline) is sometimes disclosed as berth/turnaround-time statistics rather than a percentage; this pack accepts the issuer's own disclosed operational-reliability metric for the field but requires the reviewer to record which specific statistic was captured, since a berth-turnaround figure and an airline on-time percentage are not directly comparable across companies even though both populate this field.
